# CropImageArt

> Free online image cropping tool with professional composition guides — all processing is local, no uploads needed.

CropImageArt is a browser-based image cropper that overlays 8 professional composition grids (Rule of Thirds, Golden Ratio, Golden Spiral, Diagonal Method, Triangle, Center Cross, Symmetry, Leading Lines) on your photos. Supports 9 aspect ratio presets — Instagram (1:1, 4:5), YouTube thumbnails (16:9), LinkedIn (1:1), print (3:2, 4:3, 2:3), and more. Export as PNG, JPEG, or WebP.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://cropimage.art): Free online image cropping tool with composition grids
- [Blog / Guides](https://cropimage.art/blog): Step-by-step photo composition tutorials
- [About](https://cropimage.art/about): About CropImageArt
- [Privacy Policy](https://cropimage.art/privacy): How we handle your data (all processing is local)
- [Terms of Service](https://cropimage.art/terms): Terms of use

## How It Works

1. Open [cropimage.art](https://cropimage.art) — no sign-up required.
2. Upload an image or drag-and-drop.
3. Overlay a composition grid from the toolbar.
4. Set an aspect ratio (or keep "free").
5. Crop, preview, and export.

## Privacy

All image processing happens locally in your browser (Canvas API + FileReader). Nothing is uploaded to any server.
